verdict.rationale: Reflect publishes an API reference: an OpenAPI 3.0 spec on openpm, linked from its own API docs, covering graphs, links, daily notes, notes and users/me. Its API docs include a copy-paste curl example with bearer auth, which is a runnable example. Nothing shows the reference is interactive (a try-it console or explorer), the vendor's own domain returns 404 for OpenAPI paths, and there is no sandbox or test environment. missing for 10: interactive try-it API explorer, runnable examples per endpoint, sandbox/test environment, first-party hosted reference, independent corroboration.
